product_overview: Synalytix is a unified digital identity analytics platform that brings together professional and social platform data into a single view. It helps users understand their cross-platform performance, get AI-driven career recommendations, and plan content and tasks from one workspace.
core_goals: Connect supported platforms to centralize user data
View aggregated dashboard and cross-platform analytics
Generate AI-powered career and growth recommendations
Draft and optimize content for social platforms
Plan and reschedule content and tasks on a calendar
Manage account settings and connected integrations

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can create an account or sign in with email and password to access the app experience.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Switch to sign-up or log-in mode -> Enter email and password -> Submit the form -> See the app dashboard
Navigate to /auth -> Switch between sign-up and log-in modes -> Enter email and password -> Submit the form -> See an inline validation message for invalid input
Navigate to /auth -> Enter email and password -> Submit the form with incorrect credentials -> See an authentication error message

features.name: Dashboard and Analytics Overview
features.description: Users can view an at-a-glance summary of connected platform performance and overall account health.
user_flows: Navigate to /app -> View key performance metrics and trend charts -> Filter metrics by platform -> Adjust the date range -> See the dashboard update
Navigate to /app -> View the dashboard overview -> Open the analytics hub from navigation -> See cross-platform comparison metrics

features.name: App Connections and Marketplace
features.description: Users can browse supported platforms, connect accounts, and review connection status.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/apps -> Browse supported platforms -> Select a platform to connect -> Start the connection flow -> See the platform marked as connected
Navigate to /app/apps -> Review connected platform status -> Select a connected platform -> Open its details -> See platform-specific account information
Navigate to /app/apps -> Browse supported platforms -> Attempt to connect a platform that is already connected -> See the connection status remain unchanged

features.name: AI Content Studio
features.description: Users can generate platform-ready content drafts, review optimized output, and save or schedule content.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/studio -> Enter a topic prompt -> Generate a post draft -> Review platform-specific formatting suggestions -> Save the draft or schedule it
Navigate to /app/studio -> Enter a topic prompt -> Generate a post draft -> Edit the draft content -> Save the updated draft
Navigate to /app/studio -> Leave the prompt empty -> Try to generate content -> See a validation message

features.name: Content Planner and Scheduler
features.description: Users can organize content in a calendar, create planned items, and reschedule posts by changing dates or moving items.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/planner -> Switch between month, week, and list views -> Review scheduled items -> Select a date to create a new post -> See the item added to the planning board
Navigate to /app/planner -> Create a task from the planner view -> Assign a date -> Move the task between planning states -> See the schedule update
Navigate to /app/planner -> Drag a scheduled item to a different date -> Drop it in the new position -> See the item rescheduled

features.name: Growth Recommendations
features.description: Users can review AI-generated recommendations, filter them, and track progress on suggested actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/recommendations -> View scores, roadmap items, and alerts -> Filter recommendations by category -> Review the narrowed results
Navigate to /app/recommendations -> Review a recommendation -> Apply the recommendation -> See it move out of the active list
Navigate to /app/recommendations -> Review a recommendation -> Dismiss it -> See it removed from the active list
Navigate to /app/recommendations -> Open the scores section -> Review career, employability, branding, and technical scores -> See the score breakdown

features.name: Analytics Hub
features.description: Users can compare performance across connected platforms and drill into platform analytics views.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/analytics -> Review cross-platform summary cards -> Open a platform card -> See platform-specific analytics
Navigate to /app/analytics -> Review the recommendation banner -> Open the recommended growth view -> See the recommendations page
Navigate to /app/analytics -> Open a platform analytics view -> Change the time range -> Review updated metrics

features.name: Settings and Account Management
features.description: Users can update account information, manage platform connections, and review preference-related settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/settings -> Review account details and connection status -> Update profile information -> Save changes -> See the updated account information
Navigate to /app/settings -> Review connected platforms -> Disconnect a platform -> See the platform removed from connected integrations
Navigate to /app/settings -> Adjust available preferences -> Save the settings -> See the updated configuration reflected on the page
